lede: Join the surgery online in about ten minutes. You do not need proof of address, identification or immigration status — and you do not need to visit us.

catchment.copy: We register patients who live in Willowbrook, Meadowvale, Loddon End and the surrounding villages — roughly everywhere inside the RG1 9 and RG2 8 postcode areas. If you are not sure, call us and reception will check your address straight away.
catchment.checkNote: Sample site — on a live build this section includes an interactive practice-boundary map with a postcode checker.

steps.title: Check you live in our practice area
steps.copy: Look for your postcode above, or call us on {phone} — checking takes a minute and saves you filling in a form we cannot accept.

steps.title: Fill in the online registration form
steps.copy: The national Register with a GP surgery service walks you through it in about ten minutes. Answer as much as you can — anything missing can be added later.

steps.title: We confirm your registration
steps.copy: Most registrations are confirmed within two working days. Your medical records transfer automatically from your previous practice — there is nothing to collect or deliver.

notes.title: No documents needed
notes.copy: You do not need proof of address, photo ID or immigration status to register. We register people experiencing homelessness — you can use the surgery's address. We are also a veteran-friendly practice.

notes.title: Registering for someone else
notes.copy: You can register a child you are responsible for, or an adult you care for with their consent. Tell us you are a carer when you register — we will note it and connect you with local support.

notes.title: Prefer paper?
notes.copy: Pick up a registration form at reception and hand it back in — no appointment needed. Free interpreters, including British Sign Language, can be arranged for any part of registration.
